title: is_even wrong operator
description: is_even should return True for even numbers, but it uses the wrong comparison against the modulo result.

hidden_tests.test_nums.py:
from nums import is_even


def test_even():
    assert is_even(2) is True
    assert is_even(0) is True
    assert is_even(3) is False
    assert is_even(-4) is True
